probes.command:
python3 - <<'P'
import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
names=['http_proxy','https_proxy','HTTP_PROXY','HTTPS_PROXY','ALL_PROXY','all_proxy']
a=subprocess.check_output(['apt-config','dump'],text=True)
print(json.dumps({'proxy_env_present':{n:bool(os.environ.get(n)) for n in names},'proxy_directive_names':[x.split()[0] for x in a.splitlines() if 'Proxy' in x],'ssl_verify_directives':[x for x in a.splitlines() if 'Verify-Peer' in x or 'Verify-Host' in x],'ca_pem_files':len(list(Path('/etc/ssl/certs').glob('*.pem')))},indent=2))
P
cat /etc/apt/sources.list; curl --version; apt-get --version; ldd /usr/lib/apt/methods/https; getent ahostsv4 archive.ubuntu.com

curl --fail --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 25 -sS -w 'http=%{http_code} verify=%{ssl_verify_result} remote=%{remote_ip} bytes=%{size_download}\n' -o /tmp/noble-curl https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/dists/noble/InRelease; rc=$?; test $rc = 0 && sha256sum /tmp/noble-curl; exit $rc

curl --http1.1 --fail --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 25 -sS -w 'http=%{http_code} verify=%{ssl_verify_result} remote=%{remote_ip} bytes=%{size_download}\n' -o /tmp/noble-curl11 https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/dists/noble/InRelease; rc=$?; test $rc = 0 && sha256sum /tmp/noble-curl11; exit $rc
